name: SignalPipe
description: Buying-intent scoring for your agent. Detects buyers on Reddit, HN and any RSS feed, and scores arbitrary text your agent already reads — email, Slack, Discord, tickets — through a three-judge panel, then drafts outreach. Nothing sends without your approval.

apiUrl.description: SignalPipe backend URL — set via SIGNALPIPE_API_URL env var

operatorKey.description: SignalPipe operator key — set via SIGNALPIPE_OPERATOR_KEY env var
